name: krizaka-dotgithub
description: No dependency: this file only gives the shared node-ci workflow a test script, so the coverage of scripts/ and actions/ reaches SonarCloud.

scripts.test: mkdir -p coverage && node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-force-exit --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info tests/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs actions/*/*.test.mjs
